scores.tell: Clean outline-free edges and soft rim; few internal lines. Slightly many fine dots on the dial, minor.
Truss tubes have many crisp hard specular edges and dense edge count in the background; busier than the real cards' soft lines.
Dark, thick contour-like shading at the base, the cab edges and the wheel rims; there is a hard dark edge between hull and rails. Edge density is high across the whole frame.
Soft rounded outer edges, no outline, and a thin precise inner seam on the fins. Matches the real towel and map.
Smooth edge with soft glossy highlights and no outline. The small cap ribs are the only dense detail.
The bowl rim, handles and tiles have heavy dark edges and thick grooves between the paving stones. Dense edges everywhere, and the background is as busy as the subject.
Soft, clean hull edges. The tire treads and the pebbles on the ground add many small dark edges in the background.
Hundreds of leaf edges in both subject and background hedge, with dark leaf gaps. Background edge density matches the subject, so there is no edge hierarchy.
Many thin dark plank seams and water ripple lines compete with the subject. Background edges are as sharp as the focus.
